title: Add a reward workbench to explain and edit reward coefficients
summary: locomotion.reward_workbench writes a page that describes each term of task.measured_reward with its formula, coefficients and share on recorded traces, plots each term's response, and shows the tracking reward a motionless robot keeps under each command against the docs/TRAINING.md under-10% condition. Edited coefficients recompute the reward live on the traces; the page checks its arithmetic against measured_reward on load and exports a reward_config_v1 file. The scorer and viewer accept that file with --reward-config and evaluate it through measured_reward with TaskConfig validation.
next: Use the workbench to propose Reward v2 candidates, then score each exported edit on the paired PPO and optimizer replay traces before any native comparison.
reason: An offline explanation and editing tool changes no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or the training reward in locomotion/task.py.
